final_netlist:
.subckt dut vinp vinn vout vdd vss ibias
* bias reference: sink IREF with diode-connected nfet
MB   ibias ibias vss  vss nfet W=2 L=1
* tail current source
M5   tail  ibias vss  vss nfet W=10 L=1
* NMOS input pair (vinn -> diode side, vinp -> output side => vinp non-inverting)
M1   d1    vinn  tail vss nfet W=10 L=0.5
M2   n1    vinp  tail vss nfet W=10 L=0.5
* PMOS mirror load
M3   d1    d1    vdd  vdd pfet W=6 L=1
M4   n1    d1    vdd  vdd pfet W=6 L=1
* second stage: PMOS common source + NMOS current sink
M7   vout  n1    vdd  vdd pfet W=40 L=0.5
M8   vout  ibias vss  vss nfet W=30 L=1
* Miller compensation with nulling resistor
Rz   n1    nc    2000
Cc   nc    vout  1e-12
.ends dut
